breakdown.description: The prompt forms the strain energy with a constant peak moment, even though the cantilever bending moment under an end load varies along the span.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the varying bending moment M(x) = -P(L-x) along the span, rather than the incorrect constant peak value M = PL. This aligns with the ground truth prompt, which simply instructs to set up M(x) and integrate without any mention of using a constant peak moment.
